thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired (PD #INC-2026-324) — redis-prod-eu-1 maxclients reached, multiple connection rejections detected. Auto-remediation triggered (redis-autoscaler).

alice: acked. I'm on it. pulling graphs now — redis_clients / rejected counts / p95 latency.

ben: seeing lots of `rejected_clients` spikes across both cache-prod-eu-1 and cache-prod-eu-2. interestingly, pg write latency also climbing in same window. I suspect connection churn from autoscaler restarts.

maya: confirmed - pg writes show 502/504s for embedding writes; error pattern correlates with redis reconnect storms. customers using embeddings eu region might see failures.

oncall_jordan: pd-bot shows autoscaler performed a rolling restart at 4412345600 -> that likely caused clients to reconnect and exceed `maxclients`. autoscaler has a known bug where it scales by terminating instances instead of graceful drain.

alice: can we pause autoscaling? I don't want repeated restarts while we're debugging.

sre_lead: +1 pause autoscaler. I'll also check if we can bump `maxclients` temporarily. But step one — stop the remediation loop.

oncall_jordan: running command to disable autoscaler (infra cli):
```
infractl redis set-autoscaler --cluster redis-prod-eu --enabled=false --reason "incident 4412345678"
```

oncall_jordan: autoscaler disabled, change propagated. Confirmed no more restart events in the last 30s.

pd-bot: PagerDuty: INC-2026-324 was acknowledged by alice at 4412345710. Escalation suppressed.

ben: logs from redis show many `ERR max number of clients reached` and `client close while loading` entries. sample:```
[2026-03-15T12:41:02Z] redis-prod-eu-1: rejected new client (518) total_clients=1000 maxclients=1000
```

maya: customer impact estimate: from kpi dashboard (internal link), error rate for embeddings write path ~8.4% over last 10m, spike coincides with autoscaler restarts. Affected customers: 3 high-volume embedding jobs, and some lower-tier realtime calls.

alice: temporary mitigation idea — enable read-only fallback for embedding path (flag) and steer write-heavy jobs to a queued background worker. Can we flip flag quickly?

sre_lead: yes. we'll set gateway rate-limit / write-fanout to queue for embedding-uploads. Command:```
gatewayctl route update embeddings.upload --mode queued --max-qps 10 --reason "failover for redis overload"
```

oncall_jordan: applying gateway change now... applied. Traffic shifted to queueing mode. Immediate drop in redis RPS observed.

ben: confirming redis connections trending down. rejected count leveling off. PG latencies also falling. Nice.

maya: reaching out to the three affected customers now (CS template ready). Estimated ETA to full recovery: 15–30m after queue drain.

pd-bot: PagerDuty: INC-2026-324 — status changed to acknowledged and suppressed. No new pages for 10m.

alice: since autoscaler is bugged, what's longer-term plan? We should either fix graceful drain or change remediation policy.

sre_lead: action items: 1) permanent fix for autoscaler to do connection draining (owner: ben, due EOD), 2) add `maxclients` safety margin and alerting rule (owner: alice, due 48h), 3) implement queued fallback for write-heavy embedding paths (owner: maya, due 7d). I'll own the incident writeup.

oncall_jordan: handoff to sre_lead for post-incident follow-up. I'm going to continue monitoring for 30m.

maya: CS outreach sent to affected customers. no new critical escalations yet.

alice: monitoring dashboards show error rates back to baseline over 18m window. marking mitigation successful for now.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigated at 4412345880 — autoscaler disabled, gateway queued fallback applied. Postmortem owner: sre_lead. Severity: P1 -> downgraded to P2 for follow-ups.

sre_lead: thanks team. please add any additional logs or anomalies to the incident doc (internal link). I'll schedule a postmortem and a follow-up RFC for the autoscaler change next week.

ben: one more note — we saw a small PD rebounce earlier because autoscaler retried twice before we disabled it. For the postmortem I'll capture sequence and propose a suppress window for auto-remediation if repeated restarts happen within X minutes.

alice: thanks everyone. oncall cleared from my side.

pd-bot: PagerDuty: INC-2026-324 closed at 4412345898 (resolved).
